title: Production-like deployment proof drill: prove hardened install assumptions instead of only documenting them
goal: Prove that AegisPT can be installed and operated in a production-like enterprise posture with TLS/proxy assumptions, database/artifact persistence, encryption, backup/restore, and offline-update boundaries evidenced rather than merely documented.
scope: Create or use a safe local production-like fixture for deployment proof: Compose/PostgreSQL where available, reverse-proxy/TLS declaration checks, secure cookie/public URL checks, encrypted secrets and artifact storage posture, backup/restore smoke, and offline/manual update evidence. Any unavailable infrastructure must be reported as a blocker, not silently treated as ready.
generation_reason: Backlog-186 made deployment hardening visible, but enterprise readiness still needs proof that the hardened deployment path actually works beyond development-mode diagnostics.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Deployment proof only. Do not add hosted SaaS, billing, external telemetry, or production secret material. Do not mutate active assessment runs.

success_criteria: A production-like deployment proof command or documented fixture validates health, migration state, configured public URL/TLS assumptions, secure cookie posture, and database/artifact persistence.
Backup/restore smoke evidence covers the production-like persistence path or records exact unsupported blockers.
Offline/manual update and outbound proxy constraints are exercised in a safe fixture or reported as not proven.
Diagnostics distinguish development-ready from enterprise-production-ready without requiring shell spelunking.
No secret, certificate, token, or customer evidence material is printed in logs, UI, or support bundles.

required_checks: bash scripts/verify_host.sh or documented production-like fixture equivalent
acceptance_criteria: Production-like readiness is evidenced or blocked with exact missing prerequisites.
Development-mode readiness is not confused with production hardening.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the only active task.
after_completion: Promote exactly one next approved task into NEXT_TASK.md.
